messages:
Nina: Quick flag 11: we saw a gap in KMS decrypt audit events during last night's image signing jobs (around 02:50-03:40 UTC). Cosign ran but signer logs show no decrypt record.
Sam: Which key and job?
Nina: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/sign-key; job ids: bake-20251117-01..-03.
security-bot: [alert] 2025-11-17T02:56Z COSIGN_DECRYPT_MISSING signer-service principal=signer-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Oliver: Could be IAM drift. Any recent iam policy changes?
Priya: I merged a temporary binding for ci-builder last week to unblock an integration test lane. I thought it was scoped, but maybe it got applied broadly.
Maya: Temporary bindings are the usual suspect. Treat this as potential ACL misconfiguration until we confirm.
Devon: Oncall: snapshot current key policy, export audit logs, and prepare a key rotation plan. Sam, can you dump key policy now?
Sam: Running command for record: 
```
# gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/sign-key --format=json\```
Sam: Sanitized output: "{\"bindings\":[{\"role\":\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\",\"members\":[\"serviceAccount:signer-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",\"serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"]},{\"role\":\"roles/owner\",\"members\":[\"user:infra-admin@redwood.com\"]}]}"
Nina: ci-builder should not be on that key. We planned to remove it.
Priya: Looks like infra-iam-runner failed to apply the removal due to a retry bug. I opened infra-iam/PR#412 but it didn't deploy.
Maya: Mitigation steps: (1) remove ci-builder immediately (2) rotate key to a new version and update cosign config (3) run a signed-canary and verify decrypt audit entries (4) preserve all logs/artifacts for forensics.
Oliver: Suggest small maintenance window: remove binding, wait 5m to ensure no unintended breakage, then rotate. If anything breaks, re-add binding and rollback.
Sam: Preparing PR to remove member. Diff snippet: 
```
- serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ # removed temporary ci binding
```
Sam: Merging in 10m. Tagging @Maya for quick review.
Maya: Approve. Also export cloudkms audit logs for 24h to a forensics bucket and set 90d retention.
Priya: Command to create sink: 
```
# gcloud logging sinks create kms-forensics gs://redwood-forensics/kms-20251117 --log-filter="resource.type=cloudkms_key AND timestamp>\"2025-11-17T00:00:00Z\"" --unique-writer-identity
```
Devon: I'll open incident INF-2025-0938 (sev2) and add remediation checklist: snapshot key policy, rotate key, run vuln scan on builder images, audit signer logs, and customer notification draft if re-sign needed.
security-bot: [info] 2025-11-17T03:12Z IAM_CHANGE applied by infra-automation
Sam: IAM change applied at 2025-11-17T03:12Z. Initiating key rotation: 
```
# gcloud kms keys versions create --key=sign-key --purpose=encryption
# update cosign KMS resource to new version
```
Priya: Rotation done. Decrypt logs now show expected signer-service entries at 03:18, 03:19. Sample: "2025-11-17T03:18Z cloudkms.googleapis.com decrypt requestPrincipal:serviceAccount:signer-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
Maya: Forensics: no unexpected principals in decrypt logs besides signer-service and infra-admin. Proceed with staged canary.
Oliver: Canary plan: 5 images on staging, then 30 on canary pool, observe for 30m, then full.
Devon: Adding runbook note: add TRACE_ID env in cosign wrapper to correlate build job -> signer logs. Also require infra-iam-runner fix and unit test to prevent stale bindings.
Nina: Confirmed canary staging passed. Waiting on canary pool.
security-bot: [resolve] 2025-11-17T04:50Z CANARY_COMPLETE status=ok
Oliver: Canary pool completed cleanly. Rolling to prod after 10m observation.
Nina: Closing thread for now. Maya will own the postmortem and compliance brief. Thanks all.
